title: Privacy Policy
summary: This notice explains how optc-team-builder handles device-local data, optional Google account sign-in and Google Drive backups, optional Google Analytics measurements, and public contact routes for privacy requests.

controller.title: Controller and contact
controller.copy: The web app is operated by the repository owner identified below. Until a dedicated privacy email or form is published, privacy requests can be sent through the public GitHub contact points listed here.
controller.identityValue: John Chourp, operator of the optc-team-builder web app

data.title: What data may be processed
data.copy: Depending on how you use the site and whether you accept analytics cookies, the web app may process or store the following categories of information:

items.identifiers: Technical identifiers such as IP-derived network information, browser/device metadata, and page URLs used to load the site.
items.analytics: Aggregated usage events and analytics identifiers generated by Google Analytics after consent is granted.
items.preferences: Local browser or device storage for language, cookie consent, worker preferences, favorites, saved teams, saved enemies, character boxes, character overrides, and other device-local settings.
items.content: Data you explicitly create in the app, such as saved teams, saved enemies, favorites, notes, manual character overrides, and imported/exported backups.
items.googleDrive: If you choose Google Drive sync, Google account profile data needed for sign-in and the app backup file stored in your Google Drive folder.

purposes.title: Why the data is used
purposes.copy: These data categories are used for the following purposes:

items.service: To load, render, and operate the web app and its offline-first features.
items.preferences: To remember settings and keep your device-local app experience consistent between visits.
items.drive: To let you upload, update, and restore your own app backup file across devices when you connect Google Drive.
items.analytics: To measure aggregate site usage, understand which screens are useful, and improve the web experience after you opt in.
items.security: To maintain technical integrity, diagnose errors, and protect the site against abuse.

legalBasis.title: Legal basis
legalBasis.copy: The site relies on different legal bases depending on the processing activity.

items.necessary: Strictly necessary technical processing and local preference storage are used to provide the service you request.
items.consent: Optional Google Analytics cookies and associated usage measurement are processed only after you actively consent and may be withdrawn at any time.

recipients.title: Recipients and processors
recipients.copy: Relevant data may be handled by the following categories of recipients or processors:

items.hosting: GitHub Pages and related GitHub infrastructure used to publish the static site.
items.google: Google when you use optional Google account sign-in, Google Drive backups, or optional Google Analytics cookies.
items.processors: Technical providers needed to host, secure, and deliver the site.

transfers.title: International transfers
transfers.copy: If Google Analytics is enabled, Google may process data on infrastructure outside the EEA. Such transfers depend on Google's applicable transfer mechanisms and safeguards at the time of processing.

retention.title: Retention
retention.copy: Retention depends on where the data lives and how you use the app.

items.consent: Your local consent choice remains on your device until you change it or clear browser storage.
items.localData: Favorites, saved teams, saved enemies, character boxes, overrides, language, and similar settings remain stored locally until you delete them in the app or clear browser or app storage.
items.drive: If you enable Google Drive sync, the latest app backup remains in your Google Drive until you replace it with a newer backup, delete it from Drive, or remove the related Google account access.
items.analytics: If enabled, analytics data is retained in the Google Analytics property according to its configured retention settings, while cookie durations are described in the Cookie Policy.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.copy: Depending on applicable law, you may have the following rights in relation to personal data:

items.access: Access information about the processing of your data.
items.erasure: Request deletion where the legal conditions are met.
items.restriction: Request restriction of processing in certain circumstances.
items.objection: Object to certain processing where applicable.
items.withdrawal: Withdraw analytics consent at any time without affecting earlier lawful processing.

complaints.title: Complaints
complaints.copy: You may also lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority. For users in Greece, the competent authority is the Hellenic Data Protection Authority.
complaints.linkLabel: Open the Hellenic Data Protection Authority website

related.title: Related controls
related.copy: For cookie details, terms, and analytics consent controls, use the pages below.
